AGENTS.md.text:
# Fusion health and governed observability

This is an owner-requested follow-up memory folder, prepared by the CHAT-AR supervisor. It is not an activated Mission Control agent or a new Codex task. Repository and parent instructions apply.

## Scope and authority

Track dogfooding observations, real-time rendering and shared measurements, and the eventual content-free health logger. [Chat integration and retirement](../chat-integration-and-retirement/TICKET.md) owns the transferred CHAT-AR verification/retirement close-out. [Plugin foundation](../plugin-foundation/TICKET.md), [governed events and ledger](../governed-events-and-ledger/TICKET.md), and [plugin views and provisioning](../plugin-views-and-provisioning/TICKET.md) own their respective shared contracts. Owner decisions live in DECISIONS; verified gaps in ISSUES; candidate sequencing in PROPOSALS. Documentation preparation does not authorize product implementation, publishing, Alpha, exports, monitoring or a plugin permission grant.

## Main and side roles

A future owner-designated main session fronts discussion and maintains this folder; a bounded side chat follows only its live assignment and returns evidence without taking over the main role. Inherited history and CWD do not confer identity. Neither is Mission Control. Do not register a main task or invent CHECKPOINT.json during setup. Follow the shared [ticket workflow](../../ticket-workflow.md) and [investigation contract](../../investigation-contract.md); current conversation restrictions govern delegation.

Use the local [Memory Maintenance](../../.agents/skills/mc-memory-maintenance/SKILL.md) for records and [Document Sweep](../../.agents/skills/mc-document-sweep/SKILL.md) after meaningful changes and before planning handoff. The future main session uses [MC Launchpad](../.agents/skills/mc-launchpad/SKILL.md); do not create a duplicate numbered Capture.

## Re-entry and records

Read TICKET, index, unresolved BULLETIN, INTENT and relevant linked records. H2 categories are indexed; H3 records use stable neutral IDs. Keep attribution, source links and uncertainties. Re-read before edits; side writers need exact ownership. No empty speculative extensions. REFERENCES identifies source authority; the index is static routing, never progress or a task registry. BULLETIN is advisory, not message delivery or approval.

Product changes, canonical wiki, roadmap and SPEC edits require separate scoped authorization. No timer or automatic history checkpoint is established here. A future dedicated troubleshooting task can use this folder when the owner assigns it.

CAPTURE.md.text:
# Working synthesis

> Context from the owner conversation and inspected local artifacts, not a complete history checkpoint.

## Current understanding

SPEC-06 acceptance closes the prolonged acceptance workstream. Ongoing use, bookmarks and focused Codex troubleshooting replace repeatedly reopening that workstream, but do not prove missing tests passed. Existing raw human-test recordings and Diagnostics are not the planned safe logger.

The owner wants shared infrastructure: governed schemas and subscribers, responsive rendering, coherent ledger/audit destinations, and plugin-registered views with narrowly authorized server capabilities. Four sibling Launchpad folders now own the chat close-out, plugin foundation, governed events/ledger, and plugin view/provisioning boundaries. This folder owns the health consumer and observations. The logger should consume shared measurements and authorities instead of creating another bespoke server path.

## Open discussion

Exact executable SPEC boundaries and subscriber/plugin sequencing remain to be derived from source. The owner's newer direction favors building the minimum usable plugin foundation before the logger, with the precise proof and installed path still open. Native delivery failures and backlog symptoms need evidence-specific follow-up, not an assumed common cause.

The owner permitted a temporary, content-free CHAT-AR child-boundary log while the governed subscriber is pending (D-006). It is an incident diagnostic, not the planned health store or a lasting architectural route. I-004 records the exact code and requires the subscriber implementation to migrate its useful closed fields or delete the path.

## Routed outcomes

Owner decisions are recorded in D-001–D-006. I-001 now points to the chat close-out folder; rendering, foundation and logger gaps remain I-002–I-004 with sibling contract owners identified. P-001 is the earlier sequence retained as superseded context. This narrative synthesis does not use a CAP record promotion schema.

Date: 2026-09-27 PDT.
Owner direction includes UEB subscribers, real-time rendering, system event ledger/audit paths, plugin registration and views using protected server functions. New work must plan its governed schemas/authority and reuse shared measurements; no bespoke bypass is authorized. Exact implementation order and contracts still need planning. ### D-004 — Separate content-free retention

Earlier owner choices retained: actual second DB, not a table in fusion.db; sampled numeric/health events; first of 2 GB/30 days/N events; manual queries for now. No export wiring until plugin/server work. [Predecessor HL decisions](../../../Captures/035-Composer_Typing_Regression/LOCAL-HEALTH-LOGGING/DECISIONS.md) preserve original provenance. Date: 2026-09-27 PDT.
Source: owner approval in the Mission Control setup conversation after the four-folder proposal, followed by a request for a separate remaining-chat folder and instruction to provision now. This approves durable folder ownership, not executable roadmaps or detailed sequencing.
The [chat close-out](../chat-integration-and-retirement/TICKET.md) owns transferred verification and retirement; [plugin foundation](../plugin-foundation/TICKET.md), [governed events and ledger](../governed-events-and-ledger/TICKET.md), and [plugin views and provisioning](../plugin-views-and-provisioning/TICKET.md) own their respective shared planning contracts. This folder keeps dogfood observations, rendering measurements and the health-logger consumer. The owner will settle details within the prepared folders.

### D-006 — Permit temporary chat failure logs pending the subscriber

Date: 2026-09-28 PDT.
Source: owner direction in the CHAT-AR close-out conversation: temporary logs before subscriber work are acceptable, provided they are noted clearly for deletion or migration; the owner then asked for the note in this work folder.
Disposition: a narrow exception for diagnosing the accepted-message/no-response incident (chat I-007), not approval for a permanent parallel logger, raw-content retention, a governed publisher, or the health-store implementation. The [temporary `temp_chat_boundary_v1` path](../chat-integration-and-retirement/REFERENCES.md#ref-009--temporary-content-free-child-boundary-diagnostics) must be reviewed during the subscriber implementation and either migrated into its governed content-free contract or deleted. The current development app has not restarted into this code, so no new live evidence is claimed.

INTENT.md.text:
# Intent

> Owner-directed outcomes and boundaries; not claims of implementation.

## Outcomes

CHAT-AR SPEC-06 is owner-closed with explicit residuals. Make ongoing dogfooding useful through bookmarks and focused investigations. Shape a content-free health store and improve real-time rendering without deriving the same measurements twice. The [chat close-out folder](../chat-integration-and-retirement/TICKET.md) owns remaining verification and retirement; shared governed event/subscriber foundations belong to [governed events and ledger](../governed-events-and-ledger/TICKET.md).

## Architecture direction

New cross-capability work belongs in the schema/provenance model: identify command, fact, observation, query and projection owners; reuse compatible definitions and add domain-specific ones when semantics differ. System ledger, personal chat history and optional sampled health retention are distinct destinations.

The logger should be planned against the [plugin foundation](../plugin-foundation/TICKET.md) from inception under the owner's newer plugin-first direction. The server retains protected authority and exposes narrowly permitted callable capabilities; local rendering stays local. View registration and provisioning belong to the [view folder](../plugin-views-and-provisioning/TICKET.md). Do not turn every render update into a server round trip or move core chat persistence/runtime authority into a view plugin.

## Boundaries

Separate health SQLite database; fusion.db retains personal chat, notes and bookmarks. No chat/tool text, titles, paths, credentials or content archive in the safe logger. Raw opt-in Diagnostics stays a separate ephemeral surface. Retain the first limit reached: 2 GB, 30 days or a bounded event count. Use sampling and manual deterministic queries, not generated summaries.

Exports, automatic upload, server-folder scripts and plugin distribution wiring are later work. Neither a Markdown setup file nor physical DB separation proves enforced permissions; that requires actual scoped capabilities. No implementation, deployment or MC activation is authorized by this folder.

ISSUES.md.text:
# Follow-up issues

> Sourced residuals and consequential gaps. Closure acceptance does not resolve these technically.

## Verification and rendering

### I-001 — Original final gates were not completed

Source: CHAT-AR SPEC-06 implementation report, evidence and closure addendum; D-001.
Status: transferred to [chat integration and retirement](../chat-integration-and-retirement/ISSUES.md); non-blocking for owner closure. This record is a source-preserving pointer, not a second live issue owner.
The real 45-minute soak, complete native/original-symptom verification and 06C retirement/final integrated review were not completed as originally required. Bounded automated/native evidence and human usage do not substitute. A successor plan must inventory remaining retirement obligations, identify current-byte regressions and decide appropriate verification; do not blindly retire code or mark checks passed.

### I-002 — Render backlog and runtime observations need follow-up

Source: owner dogfooding and [instant-collapse report](../../../Captures/035-Composer_Typing_Regression/ROADMAP/evidence/spec-06/06B/INSTANT-COLLAPSE/ROOT-REPORT.md).
Status: open.
Skipping collapse when a later segment exists does not establish the desired one-or-two-chunk maximum reveal lag. Record arrival, queue depth, reveal progress, stage and terminal outcome separately before attributing stalls to harness or renderer. Isolated window closure is not by itself a crash diagnosis. Bookmark/time/build references support bounded investigations; lack of a bookmark is not proof no issue occurred.

## Foundation and logger

### I-003 — Governed foundation is bounded, not generic plugin registration

Source: current UEB, taxonomy and provenance wiki; admission, handler catalog, capability factory and startup source.
Status: open dependency; shared contract owner is [governed events and ledger](../governed-events-and-ledger/TICKET.md).
Four governed fact publishers and built-in subscribers exist; general chat/render health schemas, health-store append capabilities and general plugin/view registration do not follow automatically. Existing legacy chat emit/on and full-content chat audit are not safe health subscriptions. Extend the foundation explicitly; do not bypass it.

### I-004 — Logger candidate needs architecture and measurement rebase

Source: HL release manifest and D-003/D-004.
Status: held for replanning in this health-consumer folder, dependent on the [plugin foundation](../plugin-foundation/TICKET.md) and [governed events](../governed-events-and-ledger/TICKET.md).
HL-01-6e4c29f469a4 was cleanly reviewed as a planning candidate but never approved for implementation. Shared numeric ownership with Diagnostics and governed schemas/publishers/capabilities now need explicit contracts. Rebase and re-review before dispatch. Measure once per stage; server arrival and renderer receipt are distinct stages, not duplicate measurements. Display reset/close must not reset or double-count logger state.

Temporary-path retirement dependency (D-006): CHAT-AR has added `temp_chat_boundary_v1` directly to the existing development server log for I-007 diagnosis. The closed fields are stage, UUID thread/turn IDs, fixed harness IDs, PID, selected error/exit codes and presence booleans; prompt, argv, path, stderr, provider JSON and raw error text are excluded. The owning source is [`fusion-studio-server/lib/logging.js`](../../../../../fusion-studio-server/lib/logging.js) with call sites in `lib/harness/opencode/index.js` and `lib/thread/runtime-dispatch.js`; [CHAT-AR REF-009](../chat-integration-and-retirement/REFERENCES.md#ref-009--temporary-content-free-child-boundary-diagnostics) binds the current dirty-file hashes and 160 focused passing tests. It is not active in the still-running older server process. When the governed subscriber is built, explicitly map any useful fields to its authorized content-free schema and remove this private sink, or delete it if unneeded. Verify there is no duplicate permanent emission and do not promote the temporary server log into the separate health-retention database by inference.

PROPOSALS.md.text:
# Candidate plan

> Assistant-proposed sequencing under approved direction; not an approved roadmap or dispatch.

## Dependency sequence

### P-001 — Build common contracts, then consumers

Status: superseded as a complete sequence by the owner's newer plugin-first direction; retained for provenance. The dependency details below still require source-backed reconciliation, and no replacement executable roadmap is approved.

1. Inventory accepted current code, CHAT-AR residuals and the backend/plugin/view captures; map current versus missing owners. Specify shared scalar measurements for Diagnostics and health consumers alongside render backlog fixes.
2. Define/reuse governed schemas, trustworthy producer identities, subscription grants and narrow capabilities. Separate system event ledger, chat persistence, audit projections and best-effort health retention. Keep required safety acknowledgments distinct from lossy sampled telemetry.
3. Historical option: implement governed extensions and rendering changes, then add a separate health-store subscriber before full plugin packaging. The owner later favored minimum usable plugin infrastructure first, so this is no longer the active ordering assumption.
4. Historical option: establish plugin registration/lifecycle/permissions and migrate eligible views afterward. See the new [plugin foundation](../plugin-foundation/TICKET.md) and [view provisioning](../plugin-views-and-provisioning/TICKET.md) folders for current ownership.
5. Export and server integration remain separate future choices.

Before implementation, turn this outline into dependency-ordered SPECs with exact acceptance checks, reused/new schema references, migration/retirement ownership and wiki updates. Source inspection must settle exact sequencing; do not infer a new approved program from this list.

## Dogfood intake

For an odd event, capture approximate time, app/build/profile, thread/bookmark reference, expected versus observed behavior, and available diagnostics. Record absent evidence honestly. Query only relevant local logs and primary-store references with existing authority. Do not copy personal content into a purported safe health dataset; no automatic sharing is enabled.

TICKET.md.text:
# Fusion health and governed observability

> Intake and return point, not implementation approval.

## Assignment

Owner direction, 2026-09-27 PDT: accept CHAT-AR SPEC-06 with ongoing observations tracked; place a content-free logger within the broader governed UEB/subscriber, rendering, event-ledger and plugin/view work. Preserve existing bookmarks and notes in fusion.db. Source task: 01a0c1c8-6e85-7f83-8d67-2cb5c1476007. No new fronting task is registered.

## Current disposition

CHAT-AR is owner-closed under its [closure addendum](../../../Captures/035-Composer_Typing_Regression/ROADMAP/SPEC-06-OWNER-CLOSURE-ADDENDUM.md), not certified as passing every original gate. The separate logger is not built. The old HL candidate must be rebased before implementation. Mission Control and its loop remain inactive.

This folder owns new dogfood observations, rendering measurements and health-logger consumer planning. The [chat close-out folder](../chat-integration-and-retirement/TICKET.md) owns transferred 06B/06C verification and retirement; the [plugin foundation](../plugin-foundation/TICKET.md), [governed events](../governed-events-and-ledger/TICKET.md) and [view provisioning](../plugin-views-and-provisioning/TICKET.md) folders own shared contracts. Existing captures retain original decisions/evidence and are not relocated. Read [decisions](DECISIONS.md), [issues](ISSUES.md), [proposal](PROPOSALS.md) and [references](REFERENCES.md).

D-006 records the owner's narrow authorization for temporary content-free CHAT-AR failure logs before subscriber work. The `temp_chat_boundary_v1` path is implemented in the development checkout but is not active in the still-running app. I-004 names its exact migration-or-deletion obligation for the future governed subscriber; [CHAT-AR REF-009](../chat-integration-and-retirement/REFERENCES.md#ref-009--temporary-content-free-child-boundary-diagnostics) has source identity and checks.

## Next action and return conditions

Reconcile the logger candidate with the owner's newer plugin-first direction and the contracts returned by sibling folders. In that implementation, explicitly migrate or delete `temp_chat_boundary_v1` (I-004/D-006), rather than leaving a parallel permanent sink. A bounded dogfood investigation can be opened separately using a bookmark/time/build reference; no need to reopen CHAT-AR acceptance for every observation. Report reproduction, evidence, uncertainty and a scoped proposed repair.

Return for approval of executable SPECs, not a second approval of this recorded direction. No export implementation or automatic investigation is dispatched. Operational documentation review records belong under .document-sweeps/; they are not product certification.
